show: Things Bakers Know: The King Arthur Baking Podcast
titel: Exclusive: Chad Robertson Talks About His New Brooklyn Bakery

faehigkeiten.grund: Dynamik weder belegt noch ausgeschlossen: keine Merkmale gefunden, aber eine unveraenderte Wiederholungsprobe beweist nichts

einzeiler: Chad Robertson talks about his new Brooklyn bakery, Alt Bau, in a special episode.
kurzfassung: Star baker Chad Robertson shares exclusive details about his upcoming New York project in a special bonus episode. Instead of a small pizza shop, he is opening an ambitious all-day bakery and cafe in Williamsburg called Alt Bau. The freestanding building features a dedicated upstairs teaching space and a design inspired by the Bauhaus movement.
stichpunkte: Chad Robertson is opening a new project in Williamsburg, Brooklyn, after relocating to the East Coast.
The space is housed in a freestanding building with giant windows and walnut floors from an 1800s Long Island City bakery.
The concept evolved from a small sourdough pizza place into an all-day bakery and cafe.
The upstairs level features a mill and kitchen dedicated to teaching and hosting international baking friends.
The new spot is named Alt Bau, meaning old building, drawing inspiration from the Bauhaus movement.
Robertson avoids traditional overnight baking schedules to focus on real-time, small-batch baking and fresh food throughout the day.

clips.hook: A stunning freestanding building in Williamsburg
clips.text: Chad Robertson describes the architectural features of his new Williamsburg bakery, including its expansive windows, walnut flooring, and dedicated spaces for education and pastry production.
The new Brooklyn establishment functions as an all-day cafe and bakery, intentionally avoiding the pizza-focused model common in the local culinary scene.

clips.hook: I just refuse to work all night
clips.text: Robertson explains his decision to avoid overnight shifts, balancing his baking schedule with his responsibilities at Bar Tartine.

clips.hook: The name is Alt Bau, which means old building
clips.text: The bakery is named Altbau to reflect both the character of the historic structure and Robertson's personal connection to aging buildings.

clips.hook: We are a breaking news podcast now
clips.text: The hosts jokingly rebrand their show as a breaking news outlet for the baking industry following this exclusive announcement.

beschreibung:
A new Chad Robertson venture is always a big deal, and we have all the details.
In May, Jessica talked to the Tartine co-founder for our episode all about his bread and the enormous influence it has had on baking around the world. During that conversation, Chad talked at length about his forthcoming bakery and cafe in Brooklyn, Altbau. But those details weren’t quite ready for prime time when the episode came out. So we held that part of the conversation back — until now. Listen as Chad gives us all the delicious details about Altbau, including the story behind it, and a preview of what to expect.
This is a bonus episode of Things Bakers Know. We’re still on a between-season break, and will be back with more episodes in the fall. Until then, follow the recipe!
